LESSON: READING 1.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Activities at Home and at School Suggested vocabulary cook, paint, play, learn, 
Topic 1.2: Reading 1.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 1.2.1 Fluency, part of Activities at Home and at School Suggested vocabulary cook, paint, play, learn,  in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we show emotions when reading a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 1.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to listen keenly and actively is enhanced as they listen to oral texts/audio recording and

identify words with the target letter-sound combinations correctly.

• Learning to learn: A learner’s ability to develop relationships is enhanced as they engage in timed reading with peers and give feedback.

4

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers in carrying out activities such as word building and timed reading.

Pertinent Contemporary Issues:

Life Skills (Self-esteem): A learner acquires an enhanced level of self-esteem as their reading competency improves.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner uses the reading fluency skills to learn similar concept in Kiswahili Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Large print textbooks or braille books

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Charts, flashcards, braille cards

● Pictures or picture description.
